- **Locked encryption:** you can now encrypt your Locked folder with a PIN or a passphrase, with a recovery key in case you forget it. Backups and restores keep encrypted items intact.
- **A cleaner look:** Library, Settings, Studio, Activity, Tags and Clients websites have more breathing room, clearer wording and tidier dialogs. Clicking a photo in Work shows it in the info panel; a second click opens it.
- **Magic albums:** albums can suggest more photos from the same trip, and Frameleaf can date undated photos by matching nearby shots, including by the outfits people are wearing.
- **Landmarks:** places are recognised from nearby photos as well as GPS, so more photos get a landmark.
- **Studio:** editing, export, progress and audio improvements.
- **Photo times:** capture and upload times show in the right time zone, and times you set by hand are kept when photo details are refreshed.
- **Big libraries:** the timeline stays fast and selection stays reliable in libraries with a million photos or more.
- **Moving to Frameleaf:** groundwork for bringing your library over from PhotoPrism, LibrePhotos, Photoview, Piwigo, Lychee, PiGallery2, Nextcloud Photos and Ente, keeping albums, favourites, edited details and sign-ins where possible, with every original checked byte for byte.
- **Library care:** File checks buttons take you straight to the problem and show original file names.
- **Frameleaf Manager:** now installs on HexOS, and Live Photos' hidden video halves are verified when copied to a desktop.
- **Tools:** Android direct updates were removed; install and update the Android app from its store.
